subject: Urgent: Zephyr production regressions — KV shard evictions & batching fallout
messages:
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@zephyrcorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, ops-infra@zephyrcorp.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production: sudden tail latency spikes, 500s, and throughput drop

Hi Monica —

We started seeing a big regression in our prod cluster at ~07:40 PST: 99.9th latencies spiked from ~220ms to ~3.5s, overall throughput dropped ~35%, and a lot of requests are returning 502/500 errors. This started after your most recent kv/serving rollout (we were told there was a config change around batch and kv thresholds).

Attached: minimal logs and traces (zephyr-support-logs-0302.tar.gz).

Can you please triage urgently and put someone on the call? This is impacting customer-facing flows for our clients.

Thanks —
Sanjay
Sanjay Mehta
VP Product, Zephyr Corp
ops-infra@zephyrcorp.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@zephyrcorp.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: sudden tail latency spikes, 500s, and throughput drop

Sanjay —

I'm sorry you're seeing this. I'm starting an emergency bridge now and have looped in Evelyn (CS lead) and Dylan (SRE). Can you confirm: did you see the errors start exactly after the 07:30 deploy window? Also please share the most recent request IDs from 07:40-07:50 so we can look up traces.

Joining details: https://zoom.us/j/999888777 (starting in 5m).

We requested the engineering team to pull kv eviction and batch metrics; please stand by.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Production: sudden tail latency spikes, 500s, and throughput drop

Team —

On the bridge with Zephyr. Initial look at the uploaded logs shows a high rate of KV shard evictions and repeated full-cache misses for hot prefixes. We are seeing evidence of head-of-line blocking: long sequences are being coalesced in the main batching path which is causing short requests to wait for large-batch assembly, and eviction noise is thrashing the KV-local caches.

Immediate asks:
- Dylan: can we temporarily disable the new "batch.long_prefix_coalesce" knob for Zephyr or move them to the conservative batching profile?
- Markus/Aditya: we likely need an exec note for Zephyr since they are hitting their SLAs; please stand by for a short briefing.
- Evelyn: please prepare a short customer-facing update (what we know, mitigation in flight, ETA for next update).

Attachments: kv-config-snapshot-0302.json, zephyr-support-logs-0302.tar.gz

Monica
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:49:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: sudden tail latency spikes, 500s, and throughput drop

Action log / timeline (short):
- 08:36: rolling back batch.long_prefix_coalesce for Zephyr via staged config change (hotfix-disable-batch-long-prefix.patch attached).
- 08:40: reduced global batch_size cap from 256 -> 64 for the Zephyr routing rule to prevent large coalesced batches holding up short requests.
- 08:45: increased kv.max_entries and raised eviction backoff threshold to reduce churn (rolling-threshold-change.patch attached).

Early results: p95/p99 dropped from 2.1s/3.5s to ~180ms/500ms within 6 minutes; error rate dropped from ~4.6% to ~0.7%. We're continuing to monitor.

Next steps: if stable for 30m, we'll push a staged config with shard isolation to reduce cross-tenant eviction interference. I will open an internal post-mortem ticket and include logs and metrics.

Dylan
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@zephyrcorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-infra@zephyrcorp.com, legal@zephyrcorp.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: sudden tail latency spikes, 500s, and throughput drop

Thanks for the quick action. We see substantial improvement on our end, but occasionally we still observe 504s on large fan-out requests (roughly 1 in 500). Zephyr needs an RCA and a timeline for the permanent fix — this config rollback is fine short-term but we need guarantees before next week's large customer launch.

Please provide:
- RCA of root cause (is this purely config or a bug in KV eviction heuristics?)
- Timeline for permanent remediation and staged rollout plan
- Proposed credits/SLR for the incident window (ops and legal will expect a note)

HubSpot ticket: HS-93217

Sanjay
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 20:45:00 -0800

Aditya
